initial:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a finished raster pixel-art EQUIPMENT screen for the fantasy dungeon crawler Recurant. Composition is a strict 4:3 rectangle, intended to be downsampled to exactly 320x240. Show this flat interface edge-to-edge, no device, no perspective, no surround.
Art direction: subtle, refined, restrained dark fantasy computer game UI, reminiscent of the mood and tactile aged stone of Diablo 1 and Lands of Lore, but original. Crisp deliberate large pixel clusters, no vector smoothness, no glow, no antialiasing. Muted charcoal slab with extremely quiet texture; thin dark aged-bronze inset frames, subdued grey-beige highlights. Sparse ornament only at four outer panel corners. Strong negative space; clear small warm off-white pixel lettering.
Composition coordinates below describe the final 320x240 logical canvas. Scale everything uniformly if generated larger. Outer framed panel at 8,8, width304 height224. Centered small header "EQUIPMENT" at y20, thin divider y30. A front-facing neutral adult humanoid SILHOUETTE runs from head center at (160,92), shoulders near y114, torso to y153, two relaxed arms slightly apart, two legs to y211. It is an understated stone-grey shape with no costume, face details, anatomy detail, weapons, hair or highlights competing with slots.
EXACTLY SEVEN empty framed equipment slot recesses. These are the ONLY small frame boxes in the entire UI. Do not add slots on the silhouette. Locations:
1. HEAD: square 32x32 at (144,39), label "HEAD" immediately beneath.
2. BODY: square 40x40 at (64,85), label "BODY" immediately beneath.
3. AMULET: square 32x32 at (224,89), label "AMULET" immediately beneath.
4. LEFT HAND: square 40x40 at (64,146), label "LEFT HAND" immediately beneath.
5. RIGHT HAND: square 40x40 at (216,146), label "RIGHT HAND" immediately beneath.
6. RING 1: square 24x24 at (112,199), label "RING 1" immediately beneath.
7. RING 2: square 24x24 at (184,199), label "RING 2" immediately beneath.
Each recess is empty uniform near-black inside, with restrained 1-2 logical pixel stone/bronze bevel; no drawn items or placeholders. Keep central silhouette separate from slots. The rings flank its feet. Head slot floats above silhouette. Clear separation of all elements. Text only as specified above. No statistics, portrait, inventory grid, buttons, toolbar, cursors, selected state, tooltip, extra symbols, extra slots, gems, hearts or decorative boxes. Ensure all seven labels and all seven distinct empty slots are fully visible and legible within the outer frame. Quiet utilitarian old RPG atmosphere, not chunky cartoon UI.
refinement:
Edit this equipment-screen art for actual 320x240 low-resolution game use. Preserve precisely the same seven-slot arrangement, silhouette, charcoal stone/aged-bronze palette, and sparse composition. Current tiny fine serif text becomes illegible at 320x240. Change all labels to sturdy readable warm light-grey pixel letters using a plain 5x7 block pixel font with full ONE LOGICAL PIXEL strokes minimum and dark gap between letters; no fine serifs. Render the entire image as if it was truly drawn at 320x240 and enlarged as chunky nearest-neighbor pixels: exactly 320 logical pixels wide,240 high,4:3 aspect. Every logical pixel should be one flat color rectangular block. This is a game asset, not a high-resolution painting of pixels. Reduce tiny background texture details to subtle deliberate broad clusters, and make the silhouette a muted simple flat stone-grey two-tone figure rather than grainy.
Header "EQUIPMENT": 5x7 pixel lettering at y16.
Slot labels all MUST remain exact and fully readable in 5x7 pixel letters, using at least 7 logical pixel height: "HEAD", "BODY", "AMULET", "LEFT HAND", "RIGHT HAND", "RING 1", "RING 2". Keep every label below its associated slot. Reposition labels slightly to fit if needed, never overlap slot or figure. Both long hand labels should be about 53 logical pixels wide.
Only these seven distinct empty framed equip slots: head above figure, body upper-left, amulet upper-right, left hand lower-left, right hand lower-right, two rings flanking feet below. No additional frame boxes, inventory or stats. Keep all slot interiors empty near-black. Outer border very restrained with simple beveled corners instead of square medallions, so only seven framed squares exist. The output must look like clean carefully drawn 1990s pixel art at 320x240, not high detail illustration merely pretending to be pixel art.
panel: Remove all seven slots, silhouette, all title/labels; preserve charcoal texture, outer bronze panel frame and top divider.
silhouette: Extract only central front-facing stone-grey humanoid from refined preview, transparent background; preserve stance, simplify to pixel silhouette.
silhouette_cleanup: Keep exact outline and pose; replace fill with one uniform muted grey #69655B and remove speckles/fringes/shading, fully transparent exterior, hard pixel edges.
